reviewer.note: Round 3 review at 8c212777 (PR #450), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 3. XR2-L3 fixed: the unlit glass shows a dark cradle, no pale shape. XR2-L1 not fixed: the plinth gained tooling clusters but lost volume; the lower slab's front is a one-tone region of 203 texels (#b5a897, plinth [1,14,36,28], was 192), the top planes are a single row, the lit west face shrank to one column and the bevel step does not read, so the slabs read flatter than in round 2. XR2-L2 partly: moss is now clumps, but four 4-6 texel tufts evenly spaced in one row along the joint, each with a straight dark underside; at 1x and 2x they read as a dotted green line. Bar 0.52 -> 0.57 (18.0 tones, 28.7 shapes a patch against 27, 50). Compared with the Eastward 13 lamp and 17 rocks at x1.37. Fix list: XR3-L1, XR3-L2.
fix_list: XR3-L1: give each slab its volume back while keeping the tooling: a distinct top plane 2-3 rows deep in tone 4 with a lit front-left arris, a 1-row bevel step, a lit west end face 2-3 columns wide, the front in 3 tones (no one-tone run over 60 texels), the east face in core shadow, two chips with lit lips
XR3-L2: moss as one or two ragged clumps of different size in the joint (a 2 px lit cap over a 3-4 px band with a ragged dark underside), placed unevenly, never four equal tufts in a row
